subproblem.title: Smooth homotopy identity at the level of values, via the cylinder boundary relation
subproblem.statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 and (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0. Let N, N' ∈ ℕ and F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} be C^∞ with H(ι(t,x)) = F(x) + t•(G(x) − F(x)) for all t, x. (Degree 0) Let X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) have compact support, C ∈ 𝒟_{0+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with spt C ⊆ S(X), and suppose that for every β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s,x))(J∘v) (s = 0, 1) and ∂C(β) = X(η₁) − X(η₀). If ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N'}), ηF, ηG ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) equal F^#ω, G^#ω on open sets containing spt X, and θ ∈ 𝒟^{0+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) equals (dω(H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (DH(y)) on an open set containing S(X), then X(ηG) − X(ηF) = C(θ). (Degree k+1) Let X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) have compact support, C ∈ 𝒟_{k+1+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and C' ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with spt C, spt C' ⊆ S(X), and suppose that for every β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = β(ι(s,x))(J∘v) and ∂C(β) = X(η₁) − X(η₀) − C'(β). If ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}), ηF, ηG are as before, θ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) equals H^#(dω) and θ' ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) equals H^#ω on open sets containing S(X), then X(ηG) − X(ηF) = C(θ) + C'(θ').

subproblem.natural_proof:
0. (LOC) denotes the locality conclusion of the sibling toolkit (dimred_mbl_dt_lpo_current_toolkit), available from (VO) and (REP). S(X) is compact: it is the image of the compact set Icc 0 1 ×ˢ spt X under the continuous map (t,x) ↦ ι(t,x) (WithLp.toLp, Fin.cons, WithLp.ofLp are continuous).
1. Slices of H. F, G, H are C^∞, hence differentiable. By the sibling affine_homotopy (ii) at t = 0 and t = 1, for all x, v: H(ι(0,x)) = F(x) + 0•(G x − F x) = F(x) and DH(ι(0,x))(Jv) = DF(x)v + 0•(…) = DF(x)v; H(ι(1,x)) = F(x) + 1•(G x − F x) = G(x) and DH(ι(1,x))(Jv) = DF(x)v + 1•(DG(x)v − DF(x)v) = DG(x)v.
2. Degree 0.
2.1. Apply the sibling cutoff (dimensions N+1 → N', degree 0, the C^∞ map H, the form ω, K = S(X)): there are θ'' ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) and an open W'' ⊇ S(X) with θ''(y) = H^#ω(y) and dθ''(y) = (dω(H y)).compContinuousLinearMap (DH y) for y ∈ W''.
2.2. By hypothesis θ = H^#(dω) on an open W_θ ⊇ S(X). Hence θ and the test form dθ'' = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ 0 θ'' agree on the open set W_θ ∩ W'', which contains S(X) ⊇ spt C. By (LOC), C(θ) = C(dθ'') = ∂C(θ'') (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply).
2.3. The boundary hypothesis for β := θ'' gives η₀, η₁ with η_s(x)(v) = θ''(ι(s,x))(J∘v) and ∂C(θ'') = X(η₁) − X(η₀).
2.4. X(η₀) = X(ηF): let W_F be the open set containing spt X on which ηF = F^#ω and V₀ := W_F ∩ {x : ι(0,x) ∈ W''}. V₀ is open (x ↦ ι(0,x) is continuous) and contains spt X (for x ∈ spt X, ι(0,x) ∈ S(X) ⊆ W'' since 0 ∈ [0,1]). For x ∈ V₀ and all v, by step 1 and ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply: η₀(x)(v) = θ''(ι(0,x))(J∘v) = ω(H(ι(0,x)))(i ↦ DH(ι(0,x))(J v_i)) = ω(F x)(i ↦ DF(x)v_i) = (F^#ω)(x)(v) = ηF(x)(v). So η₀ = ηF on V₀ and (LOC) gives X(η₀) = X(ηF).
2.5. In the same way, with s = 1, G, the open set W_G on which ηG = G^#ω and V₁ := W_G ∩ {x : ι(1,x) ∈ W''}, we get η₁ = ηG on V₁ ⊇ spt X and X(η₁) = X(ηG).
2.6. Hence X(ηG) − X(ηF) = X(η₁) − X(η₀) = ∂C(θ'') = C(θ).
3. Degree k+1.
3.1. As in 2.1 with degree k+1: θ'' ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and an open W'' ⊇ S(X) with θ'' = H^#ω and dθ'' = H^#(dω) on W''.
3.2. As in 2.2, θ = H^#(dω) = dθ'' on W_θ ∩ W'' ⊇ S(X) ⊇ spt C, so C(θ) = C(dθ'') = ∂C(θ'') by (LOC).
3.3. θ'' = H^#ω = θ' on the open set W'' ∩ W_θ' ⊇ S(X) ⊇ spt C', so C'(θ'') = C'(θ') by (LOC).
3.4. The boundary hypothesis for β := θ'' gives η₀, η₁ with η_s(x)(v) = θ''(ι(s,x))(J∘v) and ∂C(θ'') = X(η₁) − X(η₀) − C'(θ''); exactly as in 2.4–2.5 (now with v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}) X(η₀) = X(ηF) and X(η₁) = X(ηG).
3.5. Hence C(θ) = X(ηG) − X(ηF) − C'(θ'), i.e. X(ηG) − X(ηF) = C(θ) + C'(θ').
proof_key_steps: S(X) compact; slices of H at t = 0, 1 restrict to F, G with DH∘J = DF, DG (affine_homotopy)
cut-off θ'' = H^#ω near S(X) with dθ'' = H^#(dω) there (cutoff)
locality: C(θ) = C(dθ'') = ∂C(θ''); in degree k+1 also C'(θ'') = C'(θ')
boundary relation for θ''; its slices η₀, η₁ agree with F^#ω, G^#ω near spt X, so X(η₀) = X(ηF), X(η₁) = X(ηG)
